validationMessages.detail:
TODO: Handle Phase 2:

Superseded old version 

The previous version is immediately marked as Superseded (expired): 

All reminders for the old version are terminated. 

The old version is locked (no actions allowed for Submitter/Approver/Tax Assessor). 

Only viewing is allowed; all documents remain retrievable in tracking details. 

Reminder termination follows the Superseded termination rule: reminders shift to the latest linked request/version. 

COR/PEL tab handling 

COR and/or PEL tab remains visible but is disabled until the newest variation is assessed. 

After newest variation is assessed, the system enables a new upload accordion for documents based on the new assessment.
